title: A picker whose choice is an action must also act on the current option
rule: When choosing an option in UiSelect does more than set a value (it puts text on the wall, runs a command, moves something to the top of a recent list), wire @repick as well as @update:model-value. update:modelValue fires only on a change, so picking the option already shown would do nothing. Test it by picking the current option after another control changed the state.
rationale: E41.2 (#448): the Language picker did nothing when the user picked the language it already showed, so that language's pangram did not go on the wall; the tests only ever picked a different language.
